column1: # ⛔ THIS FILE IS HAND-MAINTAINED AND MUST NEVER BE GENERATED.
# It exists because the generated index cannot constrain its own shrinkage:
#     delete a test                  -> test-authority.py check FAILS
#     delete a test + regenerate     -> the index tracks the smaller reality, silently
# Regeneration is routine, so the index describes what IS. This floor constrains
# whether what IS may shrink without a human saying so.
# ⛔ THE FLOOR MUST NOT DERIVE FROM THE INDEX IT CONSTRAINS. If test-authority.py
# ever writes this file, the control becomes tautological:
#     delete -> regenerate index -> regenerate floor -> green.
# LOWERING the floor is a deliberate act: edit the value, state why, and let it show
# in review. RAISING it is routine and may accompany any PR that adds tests.

column2: Baseline set in v1.229.4 P1, on main 940f0253 plus the two tests this train adds.
